import numpy as np
y=-dA_dt
g=y-0.18*A**2*np.sqrt(t)
sets={'1,tp,log':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t**p,np.log(t)],
      'tp,log,1/t':lambda p:[t**p,np.log(t),1/t],
      '1,tp,1/t':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t**p,1/t],
      '1,tp,log,1/t':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t**p,np.log(t),1/t],
      '1,t,tp':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t,t**p],
      'tp,log,t':lambda p:[t**p,np.log(t),t],
      '1,tp,t':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t**p,t],
      '1,tp,log/t':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),t**p,np.log(t)/t],
      'exp(-p t)':lambda p:[np.ones_like(t),np.exp(-p*t),t]}
ps=np.arange(-3,3.001,0.01)
for name,f in sets.items():
    best=(9,None)
    for p in ps:
        if name=='exp(-p t)': p=abs(p)+1e-3
        X=np.column_stack(f(p))
        c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,g,rcond=None)
        r=np.mean((g-X@c)**2)/np.var(g)
        if r<best[0]: best=(r,p,np.round(c,4))
    print(name,best)

forms={
 'exp(-c/t)+1,t,log':lambda c:[one,np.exp(-c/t),t,np.log(t)],
 'exp(-c/t)+1,t,1/t':lambda c:[one,np.exp(-c/t),t,1/t],
